_README: PUBLIC STAND-IN settings. The cells below are EXAMPLE values (made up, no strategy). The private overlay replaces this file. Edit settings from the app, not here.
_run_budget: UNITS: US dollars per run. RANGE: N-10000 where N = number of series (>= $1 per market). Max total $ of new bids per run, split evenly across 'series'.
_max_order: UNITS: US dollars per order. RANGE: 1-1000. Max $ per single order.
_max_open_frac: UNITS: fraction of balance (0.2 = 20%). RANGE: 0.05-0.9. Hard cap: $ at risk can never exceed this fraction of (balance + open positions).
_series: UNITS: Kalshi series tickers. Markets the strategy may quote.
_poll_minutes: UNITS: minutes. RANGE: 2-60 (the cloud API caps it at 14). How often a trading pass runs.
_cells: EXAMPLE VALUES ONLY. Each row: [min price, max price, min hours to close, max hours to close, side]. Never editable from the app.
